Solis, M. and Silveira, S. (2020). Technologies for chemical recycling of household plastics - A technical review and TRL assessment. Waste Management 105, 128-138. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.wasman.2020.01.038

Locators are printed journal page numbers (PDF page = printed - 127). A qualitative review: the only technology-level numbers are Table 3 (process temperature range, scale of operation, TRL) for eight cracking and gasification technologies, loaded as temperature-min/max (process temperature, not an output temperature), trl and state-of-development, plus the catalytic cracking oil yield (flows). No energy, cost or emissions per tonne are given. Other-values: hydrocracking pressure and hydrogen cost, plasma gasification electricity shares, plant capacities from Table 2 and Sect. 3.4. Not loaded: Appendix A-E facility lists (temperatures and yields per named plant, reprinted from Samperio 2016 and Nistelrooij 2017), qualitative sensitivity/polymer breakdown ratings. Traps: Table 3 and text disagree for catalytic cracking (450-550 vs 300-350 degC) and plasma pyrolysis (1800-10000 vs 1730-9730 degC); Table 3 used. TRL is the authors' developer-type judgement, not a demonstration record. Chemolysis/depolymerisation excluded by the authors.
